displayIdentity.body: A great multitude celebrates God’s reign, the Lamb’s marriage and prepared wife, blessing for those invited to the wedding supper, true words of God, and worship redirected from the angel to God.
displayIdentity.title: A wedding supper is announced in heavenly praise
